Title: SMC AW40-F06CE-B FILTER REGULATOR Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: AW40-F06CE-B
DESCRIPTION: AW20(*)-B to AW60(*)-B, Filter Regulator & Filter Regulator w/Backflow Function
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Made to Order 1: None Body Size: 40 Backflow Function: None Thread: F (G) Port: 06 (3/4) Option: CE (Float Type Auto Drain [N.C.] + Square embedded type pressure gauge [with limit indicator]) Semi-standard 1: Standard Semi-standard 2: Standard Made to Order 2: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: This combination Filter/ Regulator minimizes space and piping by integrating the 2 units into one. Standard features include a relieving regulator, which can be quickly locked by pushing down on the adjustment knob. There are many options, which include gauges, auto-drain, metal bowl and covers, different set pressures, etc. The AW-B is part of the family of modular air preparation units and can be combined with other similar sized products. This series is available in 3 body sizes with piping from 1/8 to 3/4 in Rc, NPT or G thread types. Integrated filter and regulator units save space and require less piping. With the backflow function it incorporates a mechanism to exhaust the air pressure in the outlet side reliably and quickly.
BULLET POINTS: Modular type filter regulator. Transparent bowl guard. Available with built-in backflow mechanism. Rc, G(PF) or NPT threads.

This series is available in 3 body sizes with piping from 1/8 to 3/4 in Rc, NPT or G thread types. Integrated filter and regulator units save space and require less piping. With the backflow function it incorporates a mechanism to exhaust the air pressure in the outlet side reliably and quickly.

Transparent bowl guard.

With the backflow function it incorporates a mechanism to exhaust the air pressure in the outlet side reliably and quickly.

LONG DESCRIPTION: This combination Filter/ Regulator minimizes space and piping by integrating the 2 units into one. Standard features include a relieving regulator, which can be quickly locked by pushing down on the adjustment knob. There are many options, which include gauges, auto-drain, metal bowl and covers, different set pressures, etc. The AW-B is part of the family of modular air preparation units and can be combined with other similar sized products. This series is available in 3 body sizes with piping from 1/8 to 3/4 in Rc, NPT or G thread types. Integrated filter and regulator units save space and require less piping. With the backflow function it incorporates a mechanism to exhaust the air pressure in the outlet side reliably and quickly.
BULLET POINTS: Modular type filter regulator. Transparent bowl guard. Available with built-in backflow mechanism. Rc, G(PF) or NPT threads.

Title: SMC IDHA4-23 THERMO-DRYER Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: IDHA4-23
DESCRIPTION: Thermo-dryer - IDH
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Size: 4 (400 l/min [ANR]) Combination of built-in products: Regulator + Filter (AMH) + Filter (AME) Option: None (Standard)
LONG DESCRIPTION: Industry applications requiring stable compressed air temperature control now have the answer with our new compact Series IDH air dryer unit with integrated heater, regulator, dryer and filter. Developed for an extensive range of industry applications, our Series IDH air dryer can deliver a constant volume of compressed air at the correct temperature, dew point, pressure and cleanliness regardless of external conditions or seasonal climatic conditions. Offering temperature stability of +/-0.1ºC, with a setting range of 15 to 30ºC and a dryer controlled pressure dew point of 10ºC, Series IDH can be set with an outlet air pressure of between 0.15 to 0.85 Mpa using its in-built highly accurate Series AR regulator. Description:
Brand: SMC

DESCRIPTION: AW20(*)-B to AW60(*)-B, Filter Regulator & Filter Regulator w/Backflow Function
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Made to Order 1: None Body Size: 20 Backflow Function: K (w/Backflow Function) Thread: F (G) Port: 02 (1/4) Option: C (Float Type Auto Drain [N.C.]) Semi-standard 1: Standard Semi-standard 2: Standard Made to Order 2: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: This combination Filter/ Regulator minimizes space and piping by integrating the 2 units into one. Standard features include a relieving regulator, which can be quickly locked by pushing down on the adjustment knob. There are many options, which include gauges, auto-drain, metal bowl and covers, different set pressures, etc. The AW-B is part of the family of modular air preparation units and can be combined with other similar sized products. This series is available in 3 body sizes with piping from 1/8 to 3/4 in Rc, NPT or G thread types. Integrated filter and regulator units save space and require less piping. With the backflow function it incorporates a mechanism to exhaust the air pressure in the outlet side reliably and quickly.
BULLET POINTS: Modular type filter regulator. Transparent bowl guard. Available with built-in backflow mechanism. Rc, G(PF) or NPT threads.
